 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rail - RaiGuard Roslyn Guardrails & Analyzer for the RAIkeep Framework
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Commands:		check, fix, rules, groups  
  rail check [<path>] [--rule <id>] [--group <name>] [--json]  
  rail fix [<path>] [--rule <id>] [--group <name>] [--dry-run]  
  rail rules [--rule <id>] [--group <name>] [--groups] [--json]  
  rail groups [--group <name>] [--json]  
-h, --help		print out all options  
-v, --version		print version info  
-n, --nologo		do not display the banner  
-b, --debug		enable debug output  
-p, --path		target file or directory (defaults to current directory)  
--rule			filter by rule ID (e.g. RAI001, RAI011)  
-g, --group		filter by rule group set (OsLib, CloudSync, JsonPit, CliCommand, RaiMedia, Formatting)  
--groups		list all rule groups (sets) with their member RAIxxx rules  
--json			output diagnostics in JSON format  
--dry-run		simulate code fixes without modifying source files on disk  
 Rules		RAI001..RAI016 across sets: OsLib, CloudSync, JsonPit, CliCommand, RaiMedia, Formatting
